# Configuration options

<!-- generated by `undershell --doc` from src/schema.hpp; tests/test_docs.cpp checks it -->

`~/.config/undershell/config.toml` is applied live when saved. Everything here can
also be changed from the editor's inspector (`undershell msg edit`).

## `[general]`

| Key | Values | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grid` | px | `16` | editor snap step |
| `noise_reduction` | 0 – 1 | `0.45` | analyser smoothing (Ryoku's cava used 45) |
| `monstercat` | `true` / `false` | `false` | spread peaks to neighbours |
| `performance` | `auto`, `eco`, `balanced`, `high`, `ultra` | `"auto"` | how much undershell may spend: frame rate cap, resolution of costly widgets, particle counts, effect quality. `auto` starts at `high` and steps down while the widgets' measured GPU or CPU time goes over a fifth of the time (back up when there is room). Also in the editor's help card and `undershell msg perf <level>` |
| `on_battery` | `lower`, `eco`, `keep` | `"lower"` | on battery: one step down, straight to `eco`, or no change |
| `language` | `system`, `en`, `es` | `"system"` | editor language; `system` follows the locale (Spanish under `es_*`, else English). Also switchable in the editor's help card |
| `wallpaper` | path | `""` | the wallpaper, when neither Noctalia nor KDE Plasma says which it is (or to override them): depth and per-wallpaper layouts follow it |
| `wallpaper_fill` | `center`, `crop`, `fit`, `stretch`, `repeat` | the source's, else `crop` | how that wallpaper is fitted to the screen |
| `depth_model` | `true` / `false` | `true` | compute each wallpaper's depth with undershell's model (Depth Anything V2), once it has been downloaded (the inspector's button or `undershell msg depth-model`; a copy Noctalia's `wallpaper_depth` already has is used); `false` turns depth off |
| `depth_threshold` | 0 – 100 | Noctalia's `wallpaper_depth` threshold, else `30` | the depth plane of widgets with `depth_level = 0`: higher is nearer, so less of the wallpaper covers them |
| `depth_feather` | 0 – 100 | Noctalia's `wallpaper_depth` feather, else `8` | how soft the edge of every depth cut is |

## Every `[[widget]]`

| Key | Values | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | type name | unique name (used by `msg set/select/remove`) |
| `type` | `visualizer`, `clock`, `now_playing`, `shape`, `image`, `text`, `lyrics`, `calendar`, `notes`, `weather`, `filter` | `"visualizer"` | |
| `output` | connector (`HDMI-A-1`, `eDP-1`, …) | first output | monitor |
| `x`, `y` | logical px | `0` | position on the output (may hang off an edge) |
| `space` | `[w, h]` | the screen it is first shown on | the output size (logical px) the layout was made on; `x`, `y`, `width`, `height` and `pin` are in it. On a screen of another size or scale the widget follows the wallpaper (its fill mode), not the screen. Written by the editor; a block without it is given the size of the screen it first appears on |
| `width`, `height` | logical px | `800` × `240` | box; the design is fitted into it |
| `enabled` | `true` / `false` | `true` | |
| `name` | text | the id | what the editor's Layers panel calls it |
| `group` | text | none | widgets with the same group are selected, moved, scaled, turned, hidden and locked together (the Layers panel's Group, Ctrl+G) |
| `hidden` | `true` / `false` | `false` | not shown at all: no surface, nothing drawn (the eye in the Layers panel) |
| `locked` | `true` / `false` | `false` | cannot be picked or moved on the desktop; still selectable in the Layers panel |
| `depth` | `true` / `false` | `true` | pass behind what stands in front in the wallpaper (its depth plane: `depth_level`) |

## `type = "calendar"`

The month, the week, today's page or an agenda, today in the accent colour. Events are read from this computer only (never fetched): `.ics` files or folders of them (`ics`, separated by `;`), khal's calendars (its config's vdirs) and Evolution's / GNOME Calendar's (local ones, and the copies it keeps of online ones; hidden or disabled ones are left out). They are watched, and Evolution's cache looked at every 10 minutes.

| Key | Values | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layout` | `month`, `week`, `day`, `agenda` | `"month"` | Layout |
| `ics` | text | `""` | .ics files |
| `khal` | `true` / `false` | `false` | khal calendars |
| `evolution` | `true` / `false` | `false` | Evolution / GNOME |
| `agenda_days` | 1 – 60 | `7` | Days ahead |
| `plate` | `glass`, `solid`, `none` | `"glass"` | Plate |
| `font` |  | `"Space Grotesk"` | Font |
| `accent` | palette role (`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `on_surface`, …) or `#rrggbb` | `"primary"` | Accent |
| `ink` | palette role (`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `on_surface`, …) or `#rrggbb` | `"on_surface"` | Ink |
| `first_day` | `monday`, `sunday` | `"monday"` | Week starts |
| `weekends` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Tint weekends |
| `week_numbers` | `true` / `false` | `false` | Week numbers |
| `language` | `system`, `en`, `es` | `"system"` | Language |
| `opacity` | 0.05 – 1 | `1` | Opacity |
| `rotation` | -180 – 180 | `0` | Rotation ° |
| `depth` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Depth |
| `depth_level` | 0 – 100 | `0` | Depth plane |
| `layer` | -999 – 999 | `0` | Layer |
| `date` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | `""` | shows that day instead of today (not in the inspector) |

## `type = "weather"`

The weather from Open-Meteo (no account or key) for the `location` you write: a city (sent once to Open-Meteo's geocoding) or `"lat, lon"`. Only coordinates rounded to 0.01° are sent after that, every half hour; answers are cached in `~/.cache/undershell/weather`.

| `language` | `system`, `en`, `es` | `"system"` | Language |
| `opacity` | 0.05 – 1 | `1` | Opacity |

## `type = "filter"`

A colour filter over the wallpaper: it draws the wallpaper again (fitted as the shell fits it) through the options below, under every other widget. With `depth = true` only the background behind the wallpaper's subject is filtered. Nothing for a video or scene wallpaper. A `style` sets the options after it; the defaults below are the `custom` style's (nothing changed).

| Key | Values | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | `warm`, `cool`, `noir`, `vintage`, `dream`, `night`, `vivid`, `faded`, `duotone`, `custom` | `"warm"` | Style |
| `brightness` | -1 – 1 | `0` | Brightness |
| `contrast` | 0 – 2 | `1` | Contrast |
| `saturation` | 0 – 2 | `1` | Saturation |
| `hue` | -180 – 180 | `0` | Hue ° |
| `temperature` | -1 – 1 | `0` | Warmth |
| `tint_amount` | 0 – 1 | `0` | Tint |
| `tint` | palette role (`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `on_surface`, …) or `#rrggbb` | `"primary"` | Tint colour |
| `duotone` | `true` / `false` | `false` | Two-tone |
| `dark` | palette role (`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `on_surface`, …) or `#rrggbb` | `"#1b1530"` | Shadows |
| `light` | palette role (`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `on_surface`, …) or `#rrggbb` | `"#ffd9a8"` | Lights |
| `vignette` | 0 – 1 | `0` | Vignette |
| `blur` | 0 – 20 | `0` | Blur |
| `grain` | 0 – 1 | `0` | Grain |
| `posterize` | 0 – 16 | `0` | Posterize |
| `pixelate` | 0 – 40 | `0` | Pixelate |
| `opacity` | 0.05 – 1 | `1` | Strength |
| `depth` | `true` / `false` | `false` | Background only |
| `depth_level` | 0 – 100 | `0` | Depth plane |
| `layer` | -999 – 999 | `0` | Layer |

### Animated effects

The same widget moves the wallpaper: `fx_<effect> = true` turns an effect on, and its options are `fx_<effect>_<option>`. All effects that are on are drawn in one pass at `fx_fps` frames a second (10 – 60, default 30). Every effect also has `fx_<effect>_strength` (0 – 2, default 1), `fx_<effect>_mask` (`all`, `background`, `subject`, `above`, `below`, `paint1` … `paint4`: `above` and `below` split the picture at `fx_<effect>_split`, 0 – 1 from the top; `paint1` … `paint4` are masks painted with the editor's brush, kept per wallpaper in `~/.config/undershell/effect-masks`) — `background`, `subject` and the painted masks need the wallpaper's depth map. Your own effects go in `~/.config/undershell/effects/<name>.glsl` (see [EFFECTS.md](EFFECTS.md)).
